annotations.title: Scan a website for agent readiness

description: Score any public website out of 100 for how well AI agents can use it: reach it, understand it, act on it (book, quote, buy), complete the task, act for a signed-in customer, trust its facts, and find the right location. Returns the score, a score per area, the most important finding in each area, and a link to the full report with every finding and the ordered fix plan. Takes 5 to 20 seconds.

fresh.description: Rescan even if the site was scanned in the last 30 minutes. Use after the owner changed something.

url.description: The website to scan, for example acme.com or https://www.acme.com/

name: scan_website
title: Scan a website for agent readiness
